versions.content: Neighboring egress port queues need the same variant of availability bandwidth configuration Status: DRAFT If an EthSwtPortEgressScheduler is configured with EthSwtPortScheduler- Algorithm set to ETHSWT_SCHEDULER_ENHANCED_TRAFFIC_SHAPER, then all egress port queues which are configured for this EthSwtPortEgressScheduler shall exclusively use the same confiugration of EthSwtPortEgressQueueTrans- missionSelectionETSConfig: • EthSwtETSConfigAvailableBandwidthInWeightValue XOR • EthSwtETSConfigAvailableBandwidthInPercent
